author: Zedther
body:
Hello..
It is with great disappointment that i write this..
About 3 weeks ago, Da_Baus released this map
Christmas Combat
http://avicus.net/forums/90b96c038?page=1
I did the YAML for him.
A few weeks on, and I was thinking of making a map, when i realized I still had his map from when i downloaded it to do the YAML.
I noticed the name was "Cubal 5 - Christmas Combat" From when you download it
it seemed odd, so I looked it up online, and I found some pictures of it, and a website of it
http://minecraftmaps.org/minecraft-pvp-maps/christmas-combat/
This map is not made by Da_Baus, but by Cubal 5...
This is a direct violation of map making I believe, and action should be taken, it is wrong to steal maps just so you can post it on another server..
i hope you look into this and take action as requested..
Thank you.
-Zedd
